dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10022 IH: Community-Level Upgrades for Safer, Threat-Resistant Homes Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Gallagher (for himself and Mr. Thompson of California) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure

form.official-title: To amend the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act to include community hardening as an eligible use of assistance under section 404 of such Act, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Community-Level Upgrades for Safer, Threat-Resistant Homes Act or the CLUSTER Act.
Section 404(f) of the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act (42 U.S.C. 5170c(f)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (13) by striking and at the end;
in paragraph (14) by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following:
community hardening or cluster hardening, including coordinated mitigation across private residential structures.
